about:
My journey into the world of computer science began unexpectedly during my freshman year of college when I took intro to Java. Originally, I had been majoring in chemistry, but after having an inspiring CS200 professor, I knew I could excel in this field. Thus I becacme a computer science major.


What I find most intriguing about computer science is the boundless potential for learning. I could spend my entire life exploring various facets, and yet, I will never reach a point where I've learned everything. This perpetual pursuit of knowledge is what fuels my passion for this career.


I am currently a Software Engineer at Breakthrough, providing transportation energy management solutions. Recently working on enhancing our product offerings through API development.


Durning my free time I train heavily for marathons, work on/maintain my many personal projects, and try to master a new skill every month.
